title: Did Abraham truly love Isaac? Genesis 22:1-2 — “your only son, whom you love”
summary: Opens Genesis 22, the Akedah (העקדה, the binding), with verses 1–2: God tests Abraham and tells him to offer his only son Isaac, whom he loves, as a burnt offering in the land of Moriah. The word “love” is enlarged in red with a heart for the “o” and marked with a superscript 1.

text.text: 1 Now it came about after these things, that God tested Abraham, and said to him, “Abraham!” And he said, “Here am I.”
2 He said, “Take now your son, your only son, whom you love¹, Isaac, and go to the land of Moriah, and offer him there as a burnt offering on one of the mountains of which I will tell you.”

uncertain: The superscript 1 after “love” is not explained on this slide (possibly marking the first use of “love” in the Bible).
